markers: তুমি বাংলা মাধ্যমের একজন শিক্ষক। নিচের ন

not_measured.answer_correctness: requires a live model: correctness is a judgement about model answers, and this environment has no key (the coordinator-run live evaluation is the owner action)
not_measured.answer_relevance: same as answer_correctness: no live model in this environment
not_measured.faithfulness_live_model: the gate's local_overlap mode is reported as the proxy above; the LLM-judge faithfulness needs a configured provider and the judge prompt version recorded in the run
not_measured.injection_leak_or_exfil: measured under the mock provider: 0 leak-marker hits in the red-team responses (see leak_scan). A model-side exfiltration claim needs the live provider run -- the same scan repeats there

notes: Every measured row names its source module and the split it was measured on; rows in not_measured carry the reason instead of a number. proxy rows are documented derivations (faithfulness -> unsupported claim rate) or mode-labelled scores (local_overlap). The generation-side rows are per-item slices of one full-set run.

run_conditions.provider: mock (hermetic; no live model in this environment)

abstention_recall.note: small negative stratum: the CI is wide by construction
abstention_recall.scope: held-out test split, n=4 unanswerable items

citation_precision.note: the mock provider quotes its evidence verbatim, so this is a retrieval-breadth property under the mock, not a model claim
citation_precision.source: evaluation.generation rows, micro over attached sources

citation_recall.note: tautological for a quoting provider; reported because the definition must exist
citation_recall.source: evaluation.generation rows, macro over answered answerable items

faithfulness.note: the gate's deterministic evidence-overlap score, not an LLM judgement; with a live provider the judge mode replaces this value and the mode field changes with it

false_refusal_rate.scope: held-out test split, n=181 answerable items

format_validity.note: four SYSTEM_PROMPT section labels plus at least one attached source
format_validity.scope: held-out test split, n=181 grounded items

mrr_at_10.note: MRR@10 is macro over the split's answerable items
mrr_at_10.scope: test split, filtered (class+subject pre-filter, the tutor's lane), n=181, corpus=bundled-sample

recall_at_5.note: saturated at 1.0 on the sample corpus (CI collapsed), so this reading cannot fail; the real-corpus families in data/nctb/retrieval_eval.json are the measurement that can
recall_at_5.scope: test split, filtered (class+subject pre-filter, the tutor's lane), n=181, corpus=bundled-sample

refusal_correctness_unsafe.note: 43/43 refused under the mock provider; a live-model run is the owner action that repeats it
refusal_correctness_unsafe.scope: red-team set (not split; adversarial items carry no split)

response_language_correctness.scope: held-out test split, n=181 grounded items

unsupported_claim_rate.note: derivation documented here; the metric has no separate implementation
